steps.note: Open the single-stage event creation screen.
Enable eRFX project creation as required by the case.
Allow vendors to be added during event creation.
Configure the event as a reverse auction; dynamic extension is not an available strategy argument.
Apply the first available auction pricing template.
Add the requested product with quantity 10.
Set the requested delivery location in the first row.
Verify the delivery location was selected.
Invite three available QA vendors corresponding to Vendors A, B and C.
Verify that publishing reached a real project page.
Place the closest expressible approximation of Vendor B's bid; exact timing relative to expiry cannot be controlled.
Verify that the bid was accepted by the vendor portal.
Verify that the buyer's auction Responses view shows the submitted vendor response.
Open the buyer-side Order Activity drawer to inspect available activity records.
Verify that the activity drawer contains a known event activity entry.
